title: Leaving the Scene of an Accident
grade_or_penalty: Injury or death: $2,500-$5,000 fine, up to 180 days jail, 1-year license revocation, 8 points. Property damage only: $200-$400 fine, up to 30 days jail, 6-month revocation, 2 points
key_points: A driver involved in a crash must stop, give name, address and insurance information, show credentials, and render reasonable help to the injured.
See 2C:11-5.1 and 2C:12-1.1 for the criminal versions.
elements: The suspect was the driver of a vehicle involved in a crash
The crash caused injury, death or damage to property
The suspect knew of the crash
The suspect failed to stop, give the required information, or render reasonable assistance

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: Crash involving injury or death: driver must stop and remain; knowingly leaving is punishable by fine, jail and 1-year revocation

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Crash involving only property damage: driver must stop

subsections.label: c
subsections.text: Duties: give name, address, license, registration and insurance, and render reasonable assistance to the injured

subsections.label: d
subsections.text: If no one is present to receive the information, report to the nearest police station
